run.executedVia: Playwright runner, no browser. Each case calls the inbound API as sf.integration — the same user the named credential uses, because the echo-loop guard keys off it — and re-reads the task over cnit before and after to prove nothing was written.

case.title: Invalid outcome and met_criteria values

steps.text: Confirm the fixture sys_id matches no task, so a 404 would be the honest answer if validation ran late.
Send each malformed body to that sys_id.
Repeat the invalid-outcome sub-case against a real task and prove it is untouched.

observations: met_criteria is mandatory at this endpoint and optional on the table (TC-SN-033). The endpoint is stricter than the schema, deliberately — an attestation with no criteria verdict is not an attestation.
expected: Validation happens before the record is loaded — proven by addressing a sys_id that does not exist.
met_criteria is mandatory here even though it is optional on the table itself.
actual: outcome: "maybe": HTTP 400 — outcome must be "approved" or "rejected"
met_criteria: "probably": HTTP 400 — met_criteria must be "yes" or "no"
outcome missing: HTTP 400 — outcome must be "approved" or "rejected"
met_criteria missing: HTTP 400 — met_criteria must be "yes" or "no"
empty body: HTTP 400 — Empty request body
CAFT0001001 with outcome "maybe": HTTP 400 — {"result":{"error":"outcome must be \"approved\" or \"rejected\""}}
CAFT0001001: every compared field unmoved, sys_mod_count still 0.
case.verdictReason: All five malformed bodies refused with 400 before the record was loaded; the real task is unmoved.
